headline: Newgen Software Technologies Limited receives substantial acquisition disclosure from Diwakar Nigam under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Diwakar Nigam has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding substantial acquisition of shares in Newgen Software Technologies Limited. The filing triggers SEBI Takeover Code disclosure requirements and signals a significant shareholding change or intent.
detail: Diwakar Nigam submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the National Stock Exchange. Such disclosures are required when an acquirer crosses specified shareholding thresholds or declares intent to acquire 25% or more of a listed company. The filing indicates either a completed substantial acquisition or a declared intention subject to regulatory conditions. Newgen Software is a software services company listed on NSE; specifics of consideration, share count, and offer structure remain in the formal disclosure document.
